name: Motionverse
blurb: Design partner and co-founder. Makes the flyers, identity work and campaign artwork credited to KR8 Digitals in association with Motionverse.
long: Motionverse is where the design half of KR8 Digitals comes from. Stevenson co-founded KR8 Digitals and, through Motionverse, produces the commercial design work — flyers, campaign artwork, product and retail design — and teaches graphic design in the free training. Every flyer in our Brand gallery is credited to KR8 Digitals in association with Motionverse because that is how it was made.
contribution: Commercial design work, graphic design teaching, and the design standard the rest of the company is held to.
record: Client flyers and campaign artwork on the Brand gallery page.

name: CHIGOMA
blurb: Co-founder under the name Creative Expression. Teaches video editing and contributes video work to our production gallery.
long: Daniel works as Creative Expression and is a co-founder of the company's creative practice under the name CHIGOMA. He teaches video editing in the free training, and CHIGOMA's video work has its own slot in our gallery alongside Motionverse's design.
contribution: Video editing teaching, video production, and creative direction on collaborations.
record: Video work slot in the production gallery.

name: Next Gen Scholars
blurb: Teaches the academic door of the free training: sciences and arts, WAEC and JAMB preparation.
long: Next Gen Scholars runs the academic half of the free training. Where the creative tracks teach a craft, Next Gen Scholars teaches the subjects students need to pass — sciences and arts, WAEC and JAMB preparation — so that a young person can leave school with options rather than one narrow road.
contribution: Academic tuition, exam preparation and student mentoring.
record: Academic track in the free training.
